original_candidate_group.claim: Auth-status ignores an admin-mode cookie supplied in a later Cookie header.

resolved_candidate_group.claim: Auth-status ignores an admin-mode cookie supplied in a later Cookie header.

failure_scenarios.value: A request contains a valid configured-owner Twitch session in the first Cookie header and tb_admin_mode=2 in a second Cookie header. The authentication extractor selects Admin with an actor, but auth-status reads only the first header and returns partner presentation with isAdmin=false, adminMode=false and the partner plan.

evidence.value: Lines 141-151 use HeaderMap::get(COOKIE), which only examines one header value. Lines 105-118 select partner_response when that parser misses the mode cookie. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/auth/level.rs:212-240 explicitly enumerates every Cookie header for authentication; lines 293-310 promote the configured owner when the extracted mode is active.

expected_behavior.value: An active tb_admin_mode=2 cookie on the verified owner's session must produce admin presentation. The existing auth-status test at lines 435-467 specifies isAdmin=true, adminMode=true and the synthetic Pro plan for that state. Header placement must not make presentation disagree with the authentication decision.

countermeasures.value: The central cookie parser already handles multiple header values, and identity-based owner validation remains effective. Neither protects the handler's separate single-header parser. The inspected router middleware does not combine Cookie header values. A proxy that concatenates cookies can mask this input shape, but the handler and router accept the divergent HeaderMap state. This defect misreports privilege; it does not grant privilege.

findings.title_de: Die Discord-Verknüpfung ersetzt ein ausdrücklich gewünschtes Dashboard-Rückkehrziel durch die Verwaltungsseite.
findings.problem_de: Die Discord-Verknüpfung ersetzt ein ausdrücklich gewünschtes Dashboard-Rückkehrziel durch die Verwaltungsseite.
findings.additional_patch_paths: unbekannt; vorhandene Belegpfade sind keine Schreibfreigabe

original_candidate_group.claim: Discord linking replaces an explicit next=/twitch/dashboard with /twitch/verwaltung.

resolved_candidate_group.claim: Discord linking replaces an explicit next=/twitch/dashboard with /twitch/verwaltung.

failure_scenarios.value: An authenticated partner starts Discord linking with next=/twitch/dashboard. normalize_next treats that valid requested path as though sanitization rejected it, stores /twitch/verwaltung in broker metadata and redirects there after successful linking instead of returning to the requested dashboard.

evidence.value: Lines 348-354 replace every sanitizer result equal to DEFAULT_POST_LOGIN_PATH with FALLBACK_PATH. Lines 64 and 80-88 normalize and persist the substituted path; lines 177 and 246 use it at completion. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/auth/oauth_login.rs:24-35 defines /twitch/dashboard as both the default and an allowed explicit target; lines 68-75 return allowed candidates unchanged.

expected_behavior.value: A valid explicit next path must survive normalization. /twitch/verwaltung is documented as the fallback destination at lines 45-46, while the flow contract at lines 9-21 returns to the normalized next path. The existing sanitizer explicitly permits /twitch/dashboard.

countermeasures.value: The shared sanitizer already rejects external and unsafe destinations, so the requested dashboard path is not rejected for safety. Existing tests cover absent, invalid and fragment-bearing targets, but not this valid target that equals the sanitizer's default. Both initiation and completion apply the same substitution, so the original target is not restored later. Targeted sibling inspection found direct sanitizer use in the Twitch and partner-login handlers, not this default-equality substitution.

original_candidate_group.claim: Concurrent Discord-link callbacks swapping two linked accounts can deadlock and discard one completed link.

resolved_candidate_group.claim: Concurrent Discord-link callbacks swapping two linked accounts can deadlock and discard one completed link.

failure_scenarios.value: Initially Twitch partner U1 is linked to Discord D1 and U2 to D2. Concurrent authenticated callbacks request U1→D2 and U2→D1. The first transaction clears and locks U2's identity row; the second clears and locks U1's row. Each subsequent upsert waits for the other's row. PostgreSQL aborts one transaction as a deadlock victim. The handler returns a storage-error redirect without retrying, so only one replacement completes and the other partner can remain unlinked.

evidence.value: At fixed SHA 0ecae1370f1a80d1a101249b5c932663d69be8af, /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-analytics/src/streamers_crud.rs:856-907 starts a transaction, locks the incoming Discord ID at 877-882, clears its previous owner's row at 883-892, then upserts the recipient row at 894-906. Opposite transfers therefore acquire identity rows in opposite order. The assigned handler consumes the broker result at 159-171 and forwards each SQL error to a redirect at 248-254, without retry. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/lib.rs:2225-2271 registers these callbacks without request serialization. The same setter is also called by /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/admin_legacy_streamers.rs:304-315.

expected_behavior.value: Both valid transfers should complete with U1→D2 and U2→D1, as either serial execution does. The setter's documented transaction contract at streamers_crud.rs:845-846 covers profile writing and deduplication; discord_link.rs:246 reports a completed link only after that write succeeds.

countermeasures.value: The transaction prevents partial writes within the aborted transfer. The advisory lock prevents duplicate bindings of the same incoming Discord ID, but these transfers lock different IDs and are not serialized. The identity primary key and unique Discord-ID index in /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/migrations/20260601000000_baseline_schema.sql:2323-2328,2619 prevent duplicates, not this lock cycle. Session identity checks permit both legitimate partners and do not remove the cycle. No SQL deadlock retry exists in the setter or either inspected caller.

original_confirmation_pair.claim: Concurrent Discord-link callbacks swapping two linked accounts can deadlock and discard one completed link.

input.reason: At fixed SHA 0ecae1370f1a80d1a101249b5c932663d69be8af, opposite account transfers acquire identity-row locks in opposite order. The per-Discord-ID advisory locks do not serialize different IDs, and neither the writer nor callback retries the resulting deadlock. This is a correctness bug, not a demonstrated security vulnerability.
input.failure_scenario: Initially, Twitch partners A and B are linked to distinct Discord accounts D1 and D2. Two authenticated, metadata-matching callbacks concurrently request A→D2 and B→D1. T1 locks D2 and clears B's identity row; T2 locks D1 and clears A's identity row. Before either commits, T1's upsert waits for A, held by T2, while T2's upsert waits for B, held by T1. PostgreSQL detects the cycle and aborts one transaction. If T2 is aborted, T1 commits A→D2 and B remains unlinked; the OAuth-completed B→D1 request receives a storage-error redirect instead of being persisted. Either sequential ordering would successfully produce A→D2 and B→D1. This is a failed completed OAuth attempt, not rollback of a transaction that already reported success.

Permanent inability to replay a consumed OAuth state is therefore not proven; the confirmed defect is the aborted callback write and incomplete swap. findings.title_de: Vor dem Cachelock erfasste Zeiten können nach einer Überholung unterlaufen
findings.problem_de: Vor dem Cachelock erfasste Zeiten können nach einer Überholung unterlaufen. Ein Panic ist für Builds mit Überlaufprüfung belegt, nicht für den normalen Produktionsrelease.
findings.additional_patch_paths: unbekannt; vorhandene Belegpfade sind keine Schreibfreigabe

original_candidate_group.claim: Concurrent unauthenticated auth-status requests can panic in overflow-checked builds because cache timestamps are sampled before locking.

resolved_candidate_group.claim: Concurrent unauthenticated auth-status requests can panic in overflow-checked builds because cache timestamps are sampled before locking.

failure_scenarios.value: In a normal debug build, request A samples Unix second N and is descheduled before acquiring the cache mutex. Request B samples N+1, refreshes an expired cache, and records created_at=N+1. A then acquires the mutex and evaluates unsigned N-(N+1), causing an overflow panic instead of its authentication-status response. Crossing a second boundary is sufficient; the system clock need not move backwards.

evidence.value: At the fixed review SHA, auth_status.rs:156-168 samples now at 157, acquires the mutex at 159, subtracts cache.created_at at 161, and writes the newer timestamp at 167. The mutex protects individual accesses but does not preserve the ordering of timestamps sampled outside it. The unauthenticated request path reaches this function directly at 103-104. Rust debug builds check unsigned arithmetic overflow.

expected_behavior.value: The handler contract at auth_status.rs:72-75 says requests always receive HTTP 200 with the appropriate payload. The existing unauth_returns_all_false test at 569-585 likewise requires HTTP 200. Concurrent cache refreshes should not turn that response into a panic.

countermeasures.value: The cache mutex prevents simultaneous mutation but not acquisition out of timestamp order. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/Cargo.toml:118-130 does not enable release overflow checks, so this specific panic is not established for the normal production release build; unchecked subtraction instead wraps and regenerates the constant payload. This finding is explicitly limited to debug or otherwise overflow-checked builds. A narrow search found no identical subtraction elsewhere in the inspected handler scope.

input.reason: At SHA 0ecae1370f1a80d1a101249b5c932663d69be8af, an admissible concurrent schedule makes the u64 subtraction underflow. With overflow checks enabled, the anonymous handler panics instead of returning its documented HTTP 200 response. This establishes a correctness bug, not a demonstrated production security vulnerability.
input.failure_scenario: The shared cache contains a payload with created_at=T-5. Anonymous request A samples now=T at auth_status.rs:157, then is descheduled before attempting the lock. Across the next second boundary, request B samples T+1, acquires the lock, observes age=6, refreshes the cache and sets created_at=T+1 at line 167. A resumes and acquires the lock. Line 161 evaluates T-(T+1) as u64, causing an overflow-check panic. No clock rollback, invalid input or database state is needed.

findings.title_de: Discord-Link-Abschluss hat keine eigene Frist für Datenbanksperren
findings.problem_de: Discord-Link-Abschluss hat keine eigene Frist für Datenbanksperren. Das gewünschte Budget ist offen.
findings.additional_patch_paths: unbekannt; vorhandene Belegpfade sind keine Schreibfreigabe

original_candidate_group.claim: Discord link completion has no deadline for database lock waits.

resolved_candidate_group.claim: Discord link completion has no deadline for database lock waits.

failure_scenarios.value: With PostgreSQL statement_timeout and lock_timeout disabled, another open transaction holds the target streamer identity row. A partner completes a valid Discord OAuth flow. set_discord_profile waits indefinitely on its identity upsert, retaining a dashboard pool connection and never returning the completion redirect. Multiple distinct valid completions can occupy the available pool connections, causing unrelated session and dashboard queries to reach their acquisition timeouts.

evidence.value: Fixed revision 0ecae1370f1a80d1a101249b5c932663d69be8af: discord_link.rs:236-244 awaits set_discord_profile without a deadline. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-analytics/src/streamers_crud.rs:856-907 starts a transaction, takes a blocking advisory lock at 879-882, and performs a potentially row-lock-blocked upsert at 894-906. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/bin/tb-dashboard/src/main.rs:400 uses tb_db::connect; /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-db/src/pool.rs:10-56 sets statement_timeout only in the unused read-only mode. The production router layers in /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/lib.rs:2204-2271 provide no request deadline.

expected_behavior.value: The completion flow documented at discord_link.rs:13-21 should finish with a success or error redirect instead of indefinitely retaining a database connection when persistence cannot progress. Class C because an explicit database or end-to-end deadline is not established by the existing contract, and deployed database/proxy timeout settings were not verified.

countermeasures.value: The broker client has a 20-second total timeout at discord_link.rs:318-321, but that expires only broker work, not subsequent persistence. Partner authentication restricts reachability. Pool size and acquire_timeout bound connections and acquisition waits, not an already executing statement. Read-only pool mode configures a 20-second statement timeout, but production dashboard startup uses the writable mode. A separately configured database or proxy deadline could mitigate the scenario; none is enforced by the inspected production path.

findings.title_de: Partner-Link-Login-CSRF im Anwendungspfad ist nachvollziehbar, der öffentliche Proxyzugang aber nicht doppelt belegt
findings.problem_de: Partner-Link-Login-CSRF im Anwendungspfad ist nachvollziehbar, der öffentliche Proxyzugang aber nicht doppelt belegt. BESTÄTIGT-A und PLAUSIBEL-C ergeben keine Freigabe.
findings.additional_patch_paths: unbekannt; vorhandene Belegpfade sind keine Schreibfreigabe

original_candidate_group.claim: Partner token login accepts cross-site POSTs that overwrite the victim's durable partner session.

resolved_candidate_group.claim: Partner token login accepts cross-site POSTs that overwrite the victim's durable partner session.

failure_scenarios.value: With partner login enabled, an attacker holding an unused, legitimately admin-issued login token for their own partner account auto-submits a top-level form from another origin to /twitch/auth/partner/login with token=<their token>. An unauthenticated victim is signed into the attacker's account. A victim authenticated only through the durable partner cookie is also affected: SameSite=Lax withholds that cookie on the cross-site POST, bypassing the existing-session short-circuit, and the response replaces it with a session for the attacker-controlled account.

evidence.value: Pinned revision 0ecae1370f1a80d1a101249b5c932663d69be8af. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/partner_login.rs:219-365 accepts form bodies, verifies the bearer token, consumes its state and sets PARTNER_ACCESS_COOKIE_NAME without checking Origin, Referer, Fetch Metadata or browser-bound context. Lines 425-434 explicitly accept token=... form submissions. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/lib.rs:1475-1498 mounts the endpoint with rate limiting only; lines 2204-2271 merge it without a global CSRF guard. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/admin_audit.rs:95-102 passes this path through. Cookie construction at /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/auth/session.rs:245-259 uses the same host/path cookie name, so a top-level navigation response replaces an existing durable cookie.

expected_behavior.value: An unsolicited cross-site request must not install another person's authenticated partner identity in the victim's browser. The existing-session protection is explicitly intended to avoid identity replacement at /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/partner_login.rs:241-247. The parallel OAuth login rejects foreign browser contexts before creating a session at /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/auth_login.rs:301-322.

countermeasures.value: Admin-only issuance, HMAC verification, short expiry, atomic single use, stable target IDs, rate limiting and User-Agent binding are present. They authenticate the attacker's valid token, not the victim's login intent. SameSite=Lax does not prevent setting a cookie through a cross-site top-level navigation and makes the existing-session check ineffective on that POST. The issuance endpoint has an origin guard, but redemption does not. No production proxy or browser probes were performed; deployment-specific proxy restrictions remain for independent verification.

input.reason: Login-CSRF ist am festen SHA belegt. Der vorhandene Sitzungsschutz prüft ausschließlich mitgesendete Cookies. SameSite=Lax unterdrückt diese bei einem fremden Top-Level-POST, verhindert aber nicht das Setzen des neuen Cookies in dessen Antwort. Der Login prüft weder Origin noch einen browsergebundenen Login-State. Dadurch kann eine fremde Anmeldung die bestehende dauerhafte Browsersitzung ersetzen.
input.failure_scenario: Bei aktiviertem Partner-Login besitzt ein Angreifer einen gültigen, noch unbenutzten Login-Token für seinen eigenen aktiven Partnerzugang. Innerhalb der 180 Sekunden Gültigkeit lässt seine Webseite ein Formular per Top-Level-POST an /twitch/auth/partner/login absenden. Das Opfer hat bereits ausschließlich eine gültige twitch_dash_session_partner-Sitzung. Wegen SameSite=Lax wird deren Cookie nicht mitgesendet, sodass der bestehende Sitzungsschutz nicht greift. Der Handler verbraucht den Angreifer-Token, erzeugt eine Sitzung für dessen Partneridentität mit dem User-Agent des Opfers und setzt dasselbe Cookie mit Path=/. Der Browser ersetzt das Opfer-Cookie und verwendet danach die Angreiferidentität. Die ursprüngliche Datenbankzeile wird dabei nicht überschrieben; betroffen ist die dauerhafte Browsersitzung.
expected_behavior_evidence: /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/partner_login.rs:241-246 verlangt bei bestehender Admin-, Partner- oder dauerhafter Partner-Sitzung einen Abbruch vor Token-Verbrauch, Sitzungserstellung und Set-Cookie.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/partner_login.rs:617-665 testet diese Erhaltung mit explizit mitgesendetem Admin-Cookie. Das belegt die Schutzabsicht, simuliert aber keine SameSite-Unterdrückung.
reachability_evidence: /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/lib.rs:1475-1498 registriert den öffentlichen POST-Handler nur mit Rate-Limit. :2204-2271 integriert ihn ohne globalen CSRF-Guard in den produktiven Router; /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/bin/tb-dashboard/src/main.rs:476-540 ergänzt Sitzungskonfiguration, keinen Herkunftsschutz.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/partner_login.rs:174-209 erzeugt adminseitig einen Partner-Login-Token und gibt ihn zurück. :218-224 und :415-434 akzeptieren einen normalen Formular-POST, ohne JSON-Zwang oder obligatorischen Spezialheader.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/partner_login.rs:389-412 erkennt bestehende Sitzungen nur über Request-Cookies. :325-364 erzeugt anschließend eine dauerhafte Sitzung und setzt twitch_dash_session_partner mit SameSite=Lax.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/auth/session.rs:695-734 bindet die neue Sitzung an den User-Agent des einlösenden Browsers; :245-259 setzt Path=/ ohne abweichende Domain. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/auth/level.rs:371-393 verwendet dieses Cookie zur Partnerauthentifizierung.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/auth/session.rs:968-995 persistiert neue Sitzungen ohne Bindung an eine vorherige Browseridentität. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/ops/systemd/twitch-runtime-roles.sql:62-65 gewährt dem Dashboard die benötigten Schreibrechte.
countermeasures: Der Existing-Session-Short-Circuit funktioniert bei mitgesendeten gültigen Cookies, nicht beim beschriebenen fremden POST.
Adminpflicht und Herkunftsprüfung schützen die Token-Ausstellung, nicht die Einlösung. Der Angriff benötigt einen legitimen eigenen Token, keine Signaturfälschung und keinen Token des Opfers.
HMAC, 180-Sekunden-Gültigkeit, atomarer Einmalverbrauch und Partner-ID-Prüfung begrenzen den Angriff, verhindern aber die erste fremd ausgelöste Einlösung nicht.
Die Fingerprint-Prüfung schützt gegen Cookie-Übertragung auf einen anderen Browser. Hier wird der Fingerprint bereits aus dem Opferbrowser erzeugt.
Rate-Limit, HttpOnly, Secure und X-Frame-Options verhindern keinen einzelnen HTTPS-Formular-POST als Top-Level-Navigation. Fehlende CORS-Freigabe ist für diesen Navigationsangriff kein Hindernis.
gaps: Statische Prüfung ausschließlich an 0ecae1370f1a80d1a101249b5c932663d69be8af. Keine Browserprobes und keine Tests ausgeführt.

findings.title_de: Steam-Linking bei nichtkanonischem Twitch-OAuth-Host kann die Playersitzung verlieren
findings.problem_de: Steam-Linking bei nichtkanonischem Twitch-OAuth-Host kann die Playersitzung verlieren. Host- und Produktvertrag bleiben C.
findings.additional_patch_paths: unbekannt; vorhandene Belegpfade sind keine Schreibfreigabe

original_candidate_group.claim: Steam linking loses the player session when Twitch OAuth uses a noncanonical host.

resolved_candidate_group.claim: Steam linking loses the player session when Twitch OAuth uses a noncanonical host.

failure_scenarios.value: Serve the dashboard and register its Twitch OAuth callback on another HTTPS host. Twitch login succeeds and sets twitch_player_session on that host. Submitting the Steam form instead creates a callback on deutsche-deadlock-community.de. The browser does not send the other host's cookie there, so steam_callback returns 401 without linking the account.

evidence.value: At review SHA 0ecae137, player_connect.rs:107-110 derives connect_origin from the fixed CONNECT_URL; line 358 always prefers it over the configured OAuth origin. Lines 317-323 issue the player cookie using session.rs:245-259, which sets no Domain attribute. Lines 396-403 require that cookie on the Steam callback. run_tb_dashboard_service.sh:114-118 explicitly permits overriding the OAuth redirect URI.

expected_behavior.value: If alternate OAuth hosts are supported, the Steam round-trip should return to the host holding the player session. Otherwise the host restriction should be explicit. Alternate-host support is not sufficiently established to classify this as B.

countermeasures.value: The canonical default OAuth URI avoids this scenario. Form-origin validation accepts the configured origin but cannot transfer a host-only cookie. Session binding, OpenID verification and revision checks correctly fail closed. Actual proxy canonicalization was not established; this is a configuration-dependent C finding, not a demonstrated failure of the default deployment.

findings.title_de: Ein Steam-Defaultwechsel kann eine parallel entfernte Kontozuordnung wieder aktivieren.
findings.problem_de: Ein Steam-Defaultwechsel kann eine parallel entfernte Kontozuordnung wieder aktivieren.
findings.additional_patch_paths: unbekannt; vorhandene Belegpfade sind keine Schreibfreigabe

original_candidate_group.claim: Changing the Steam default can reactivate an association already removed by a concurrent unlink.

resolved_candidate_group.claim: Changing the Steam default can reactivate an association already removed by a concurrent unlink.

failure_scenarios.value: Two authenticated requests use the same valid player session. The primary-selection transaction checks that account B exists, then pauses. Unlink deletes every account, disables lookup and commits successfully. Primary selection resumes, updates zero account rows, then unconditionally sets the parent Steam ID to B and lookup_enabled=true. Both handlers redirect successfully, but the removed association is active again. Concurrent removal of B alone similarly produces an enabled default absent from the account list.

A viewer has primary account A and secondary account B. Set-primary(B) observes EXISTS(B)=true and pauses. Remove-account(B) deletes B, increments the parent revision, and commits. Set-primary then clears A's primary flag, updates zero rows when marking B primary, writes B into the parent, and commits successfully. Both HTTP actions report success, but no stored account is primary and rank lookup still uses the removed account B.

evidence.value: At pinned revision 0ecae1370f1a80d1a101249b5c932663d69be8af, /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-chat/src/player_links.rs:146-185 performs an unlocked EXISTS check, ignores the affected-row count when selecting the account, and updates the parent without checking its revision. The handler at line 489 exposes this path. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-chat/src/rank_lookup.rs:194-208 subsequently reads the enabled parent association without checking account membership. This is a static SQL interleaving, not an executed reproduction.

The assigned account-management test at player_connect/tests.rs:430-487 invokes handlers that directly call these storage operations. In player_links.rs:147-156, the membership check takes no row lock. Lines 167-174 ignore the affected-row count when selecting B; lines 175-184 unconditionally write B into the parent and commit. original_candidate_group.claim: Concurrent removal of two Steam accounts can retain a deleted account as the enabled default.

resolved_candidate_group.claim: Concurrent removal of two Steam accounts can retain a deleted account as the enabled default.

failure_scenarios.value: An association contains primary account A and secondary account B. Removing A deletes it and selects B as the replacement, then pauses. A concurrent request deletes B and commits its revision update. The first request resumes, updates zero rows when promoting B, nevertheless writes B into the parent association and commits. Both removals report success, the account list is empty, and rank lookup still uses B.

A viewer has primary account A and secondary account B. Remove-account(A) deletes A and selects B as its replacement without locking B. Before it promotes B, another request removes B as a non-primary account and commits. The first request then updates zero B rows, writes B into the parent, and commits. Both removals succeed, the account list is empty, but the parent remains enabled and points to removed account B.

evidence.value: At the pinned review revision, /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-chat/src/player_links.rs:194-234 selects a replacement without locking it, ignores the promotion UPDATE's affected-row count, and writes the previously selected ID to the parent. The nonprimary-removal branch at lines 235-245 can commit between replacement selection and promotion. The route at line 527 invokes this helper directly. This is the replacement-selection twin of the stale default-selection race.

player_links.rs:194-215 deletes the requested account and performs an unlocked replacement SELECT. Lines 217-224 ignore whether promotion updated a row, and 226-234 write the selected replacement into the parent regardless. The concurrent non-primary removal follows 235-245 and does not depend on the first request's uncommitted deletion of A. This is a twin of the set_primary membership race reached through the assigned player_connect/tests.rs:430-487 account-removal path.

expected_behavior.value: Removing the primary must promote an account that remains linked, or leave the parent Steam ID null when none remain. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-chat/src/player_links.rs:298-320 tests removal and promotion, and /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/migrations/20260920170000_twitch_player_multi_steam.sql:1-3 identifies the parent Steam ID as the selected account.

Removal must promote an account that still exists, or clear the parent Steam ID when none remain. The replacement Option branch at player_links.rs:207-234 expresses that contract, and player_connect/tests.rs:484-487 and player_links.rs:298-315 require the surviving stored account to become primary.

countermeasures.value: Transactions make each individual request atomic but do not serialize replacement selection against another account deletion. Each request increments the parent revision only after its account operation. The child foreign key references the Twitch ID, not the selected Steam ID, so it permits this dangling default; the unique-primary index permits an empty account list.

DELETE locks A, not the subsequently selected replacement B. The replacement query has no FOR UPDATE, promotion checks no affected-row count, and parent revision updates are unconditional. The unique-primary index and parent-directed foreign key cannot reject a parent pointing to a deleted child account. HTTP authentication and rate limiting do not serialize the viewer's removal requests.

Sollverhalten und öffentliche Aufrufer sind belegt. Das ist ein Korrektheitsfehler, keine belegte Sicherheitslücke.
input.failure_scenario: Ein angemeldeter Zuschauer besitzt genau zwei verifizierte Konten: A ist Standard, B ist zusätzlich verbunden; lookup_enabled=TRUE. Zwei gültige POSTs aus zwei geöffneten Seiten entfernen gleichzeitig A und B. T_A löscht A und erhält removed_primary=true. T_B löscht B, erhält removed_primary=false, hat aber noch nicht committed. T_A liest B als Ersatz, weil der normale SELECT die uncommittete Löschung von T_B nicht sieht. T_B erhöht anschließend die Revision der gemeinsamen Linkzeile und committed. T_A versucht nun, B zum Standard zu machen: Das UPDATE ändert null Zeilen, was ungeprüft akzeptiert wird. Danach schreibt T_A steam_id64=B in die Linkzeile und committed ebenfalls. Beide Handler melden Erfolg durch HTTP 303. Die Kontentabelle ist leer, die Linkzeile enthält jedoch B bei lookup_enabled=TRUE. Eine danach begonnene Rangabfrage verwendet weiterhin B. Beleg für den vollständigen Ablauf: /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-chat/src/player_links.rs:193-246.

original_candidate_group.claim: Unlink can report success while retaining a Steam account inserted by a concurrent callback.

resolved_candidate_group.claim: Unlink can report success while retaining a Steam account inserted by a concurrent callback.

failure_scenarios.value: A viewer has a prepared association with no accounts and an outstanding valid Steam callback. Unlink executes its account DELETE, which finds nothing, then pauses. The callback completes successfully, updates the parent revision and inserts account A. Unlink resumes, disables the parent and commits without deleting A. The endpoint reports successful removal, but A remains stored. A later verified connection to B exposes both A and B again.

A viewer has a prepared link at revision r, no stored Steam accounts, and an outstanding verified callback. Disconnect deletes zero account rows and pauses before updating the parent. The callback completes at revision r, inserts account A, and commits. Disconnect then updates the parent to disabled and commits successfully. Account A remains in twitch_player_steam_accounts despite the successful removal of all links. A later fresh connection makes that supposedly removed account visible again.

evidence.value: At the pinned review revision, /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-chat/src/player_links.rs:53-63 deletes child rows before acquiring the parent write lock. Conversely, complete at lines 91-137 locks and updates the parent before inserting an account. The stated interleaving allows the callback to commit between unlink's DELETE and parent update. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/migrations/20260918100000_twitch_player_steam_links.sql:20-33 clears only the parent's Steam ID. No trigger removes child accounts when lookup is disabled.

Tracing the assigned unlink test in player_connect/tests.rs:524-550 reaches player_connect.rs:538-566 and player_links.rs:53-64. Disconnect deletes children before locking/updating their parent. Complete locks the parent at 92-102 and inserts the account at 124-133. The interleaving therefore permits both operations to succeed. The storage test at player_links.rs:298-320 explicitly requires accounts() to be empty after disconnect. All cited sources match review SHA 0ecae1370f1a80d1a101249b5c932663d69be8af.

expected_behavior.value: The action labelled 'Alle Steam-Verknüpfungen entfernen' must remove all account rows, not just hide them until reconnection. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-chat/src/player_links.rs:298-320 explicitly asserts an empty account list after disconnect.

The rendered action in player_connect.rs:257 removes all Steam links. Storage tests require an empty account list and a disabled parent with no Steam ID after disconnect, including when a previously pending callback overlaps the removal.

countermeasures.value: Atomic flow consumption and callback CAS prevent replay and callbacks that observe an already incremented revision. They do not prevent a callback committing before unlink updates that revision. The child foreign key cascades only when the parent is deleted, whereas unlink updates it. Lookup-disabled checks prevent immediate rank disclosure but do not remove the retained association. The viewer route's 30-per-minute limiter allows overlapping requests and does not serialize handler execution.

Complete has revision CAS and nonce uniqueness, but disconnect increments the revision only after its child deletion, so the callback can win before that increment. The migration trigger clears only the parent's steam_id64. The child foreign key cascades only on parent deletion, not on disabling. Transactions and the unique-primary index do not prevent this interleaving. The sequential pending-callback test does not exercise it.

input.reason: Die Löschung der Konten erfolgt vor der Änderung der gemeinsamen Revisionszeile. Unter PostgreSQL READ COMMITTED kann ein gültiger Callback dazwischen ein Konto vollständig speichern. Unlink deaktiviert anschließend nur die Hauptzuordnung und meldet Erfolg, obwohl das neue Konto erhalten bleibt. Das widerspricht dem ausdrücklich belegten Vertrag, alle Steam-Verknüpfungen zu entfernen. Keine belegte Sicherheitslücke: Die automatische Zuordnung bleibt deaktiviert.
input.failure_scenario: Ein angemeldeter Viewer hat einen gestarteten Steam-Auftrag mit Revision 0, aber noch keine Steam-Konten. Zwei Tabs verwenden dieselbe gültige Anmeldung. (1) Unlink beginnt seine Transaktion; DELETE findet null Konten. (2) Vor dem anschließenden UPSERT führt der gültige Steam-Callback complete aus: Revision 0 stimmt, die Hauptzuordnung wird aktualisiert, ein frischer Nonce gespeichert und Konto B eingefügt; der Callback committet. (3) Unlink setzt danach lookup_enabled=FALSE und erhöht die aktuelle Revision ohne Vergleich. Der Trigger leert ausschließlich steam_id64 der Hauptzuordnung. Unlink committet und liefert HTTP 303 nach /twitch/connect. Konto B bleibt in twitch_player_steam_accounts erhalten. Bei READ COMMITTED und mindestens zwei Poolverbindungen benötigen beide Transaktionen weder eine Constraint-Verletzung noch einen Deadlock.

original_judgment.reason: Die Löschung der Konten erfolgt vor der Änderung der gemeinsamen Revisionszeile. Unter PostgreSQL READ COMMITTED kann ein gültiger Callback dazwischen ein Konto vollständig speichern. Unlink deaktiviert anschließend nur die Hauptzuordnung und meldet Erfolg, obwohl das neue Konto erhalten bleibt. Das widerspricht dem ausdrücklich belegten Vertrag, alle Steam-Verknüpfungen zu entfernen. Keine belegte Sicherheitslücke: Die automatische Zuordnung bleibt deaktiviert.
original_judgment.failure_scenario: Ein angemeldeter Viewer hat einen gestarteten Steam-Auftrag mit Revision 0, aber noch keine Steam-Konten. Zwei Tabs verwenden dieselbe gültige Anmeldung. (1) Unlink beginnt seine Transaktion; DELETE findet null Konten. (2) Vor dem anschließenden UPSERT führt der gültige Steam-Callback complete aus: Revision 0 stimmt, die Hauptzuordnung wird aktualisiert, ein frischer Nonce gespeichert und Konto B eingefügt; der Callback committet. (3) Unlink setzt danach lookup_enabled=FALSE und erhöht die aktuelle Revision ohne Vergleich. Der Trigger leert ausschließlich steam_id64 der Hauptzuordnung. Unlink committet und liefert HTTP 303 nach /twitch/connect. Konto B bleibt in twitch_player_steam_accounts erhalten. Bei READ COMMITTED und mindestens zwei Poolverbindungen benötigen beide Transaktionen weder eine Constraint-Verletzung noch einen Deadlock.

original_candidate_group.claim: Expired Steam-link requests accumulate without an implemented expiry cleanup.

resolved_candidate_group.claim: Expired Steam-link requests accumulate without an implemented expiry cleanup.

failure_scenarios.value: An authenticated viewer repeatedly starts Steam linking but abandons the Steam page. Every accepted request inserts a fresh row. After ten minutes, even a late callback cannot delete that row. Continued use, with renewed Twitch sessions as necessary, grows retained database storage indefinitely unless an external cleaner exists; finite database storage can eventually be exhausted and subsequent login writes fail.

evidence.value: Verified against 0ecae1370f1a80d1a101249b5c932663d69be8af. original_candidate_group.claim: Steam completion and primary selection acquire row locks in opposite orders and can deadlock.

resolved_candidate_group.claim: Steam completion and primary selection acquire row locks in opposite orders and can deadlock.

failure_scenarios.value: A viewer has primary A, secondary B, and a pending verified connection for C. Completion updates and locks the parent link row. Concurrent set-primary(B) clears A's primary flag and marks B primary, locking the account rows. Completion then waits to update A's account row, while set-primary waits to update the parent. PostgreSQL detects the deadlock and aborts one transaction. If completion is aborted, its already-consumed OAuth flow cannot be retried, and the valid Steam connection returns 503.

evidence.value: Complete acquires the parent first at player_links.rs:92-102 and account rows second at 117-133. Set-primary acquires account rows at 160-174 and the parent second at 175-183. Public player_connect.rs:416-425 consumes the Steam flow before calling complete at 454-457; storage errors become unavailable responses. Session flow consumption is an atomic DELETE RETURNING in auth/session.rs:1208-1228, so rollback of the later storage transaction cannot restore it. The assigned roundtrip and management tests exercise these paths separately, not concurrently.

expected_behavior.value: Concurrent valid account operations should either complete consistently or return the intentional revision conflict, rather than fail through a lock-order cycle and destroy a valid pending connection. The complete contract at player_links.rs:81-83 explicitly covers concurrent relinking, and the racing-completions test at 355-364 requires a normal winner and loser.

countermeasures.value: Revision CAS protects overlapping completions but cannot prevent a parent/account lock-order inversion. Unique-primary and nonce constraints do not remove the cycle. These methods call pool.begin directly and have no deadlock retry. Disconnect and remove_account also acquire account rows before the parent, making them lock-order twins. The public route's 30-per-minute limiter calls next.run after its reservation and does not hold a handler-serialization lock.

original_judgment.failure_scenario: Twitch-Nutzer 111 hat Konto A = STEAM64_BASE+42 als Standard und Konto B = STEAM64_BASE+84 zusätzlich verbunden; die Revision ist r. Ein gültiger Steam-Auftrag für Konto C = STEAM64_BASE+126 wurde mit Revision r vorbereitet. Zwei Tabs derselben Anmeldung senden den verifizierten Callback und die gültige Standardauswahl für B. T1 complete aktualisiert die Link-Zeile mit Revision r und hält deren Schreibsperre. T2 set_primary setzt A auf is_primary=FALSE und B auf TRUE und hält beide Kontozeilen gesperrt. T2 wartet anschließend beim Link-UPDATE auf T1. T1 versucht das bisherige Standardkonto A zu aktualisieren und wartet auf T2; dessen uncommittete Änderung ist noch nicht sichtbar. PostgreSQL erkennt den Deadlock und bricht eine Transaktion ab. Der Fehler wird ohne Wiederholung als HTTP 503 weitergegeben. Falls der Callback abgebrochen wird, ist sein separat verbrauchter Auftrag bereits verloren.

resolved_candidate_group.claim: Admin chat-action POSTs execute without validating the required form CSRF token.

original_members.claim: Admin chat-action POSTs execute without validating the required form CSRF token.
original_members.failure_scenario: An authenticated Discord owner submits login=<active-partner>&message=hello with csrf_token omitted or incorrect. Auth, owner and partner checks pass, and bridge_chat_action dispatches the message despite the invalid CSRF proof.
original_members.evidence: Verified against 0ecae1370f1a80d1a101249b5c932663d69be8af. The handler parses the form at line 74, checks the owner at 77-91, and sends at 130-131 without reading csrf_token or checking Origin/Referer. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/lib.rs:1501-1572 explicitly excludes legacy forms from header-CSRF middleware because handlers must validate body-CSRF themselves; the chat-action route has no replacement layer. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/legacy_form.rs:34-58 implements the required gate. The client supplies csrf_token at /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/bot/admin_dashboard/src/api/client.ts:1195-1205. Inspected sibling legacy write handlers invoke their form-CSRF gates.
original_members.expected_behavior: Reject missing or invalid session-bound form-CSRF proof before dispatching any owner chat action, consistently with the legacy-form router contract and sibling handlers.
original_members.countermeasures: The owner-session check, partner gate and internal API authentication remain effective against unauthenticated callers, but do not verify request intent. SameSite=Lax blocks ordinary different-site browser POSTs. No attacker-controlled same-site origin or live proxy configuration was established, so this is classified B for the proven validation-contract violation rather than A for a proven external exploit. The documented Caddy forward-auth checks session/device validity, not the form token.

claim.claim: Admin chat-action POSTs execute without validating the required form CSRF token.

result.reason: Am festen SHA 0ecae1370f1a80d1a101249b5c932663d69be8af ist der fehlende Form-CSRF-Check bestätigt. Der dokumentierte und implementierte Legacy-Form-Vertrag verlangt die Prüfung, aber chat_action_handler prüft nur Admin-Rechte, Owner und Partnerstatus. Klasse B: Der erreichbare Vertragsbruch ist belegt; ein fremdseitig auslösbarer Browserangriff für Klasse A ist nicht nachgewiesen.
result.failure_scenario: Eine gültige Sitzung des freigeschalteten Discord-Owners im Admin-Kontext sendet POST /twitch/admin/chat_action mit Content-Type application/x-www-form-urlencoded und login=nani&mode=message&message=hi&csrf_token=falsch. nani ist ein vorhandener, nicht archivierter Partner ohne manuelle Abmeldung; die Bot-Bridge ist betriebsbereit. Obwohl der präsentierte Wert nicht dem Sitzungstoken entspricht, erreicht der Request bridge_chat_action und den Chat-Send. Erwartet wäre die Ablehnung vor dem Send. Das vollständige Weglassen von csrf_token hat denselben Effekt.
expected_behavior_evidence: /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/lib.rs:1501-1508 verlangt für diesen Legacy-Form-Router ausdrücklich handlerseitige Body-CSRF-Prüfung; :1567-1569 registriert darin chat_action.
/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/legacy_form.rs:34-58 liest csrf_token und lehnt ungültige Werte ab; :78-96 validiert gegen die Sitzung.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/auth/session.rs:1530-1559 akzeptiert ausschließlich einen exakten, nicht leeren Sitzungstoken. :3020-3027 enthält Ablehnungsassertionen für falsche und leere Werte.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/bot/admin_dashboard/src/api/client.ts:974-991 verweigert fehlende Tokens bereits clientseitig; :1195-1205 sendet sie im Formularbody, auch für chat_action über :1274-1280.
reachability_evidence: /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/bin/tb-dashboard/src/main.rs:476-483 baut den produktiven Router; :517-524 injiziert den Sitzungszustand. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/lib.rs:2232 integriert den Legacy-Form-Router ohne globalen CSRF-Layer.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/auth/level.rs:243-261 und :401-473 ermöglichen Admin-Authentifizierung über eine gültige Master-Sitzung im Admin-Kontext.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/admin_chat_action.rs:64-150 enthält keinen Token- oder Herkunftscheck; :118-131 führt nach Partnerprüfung zur Bridge; :260-275 überträgt nur mode, color und message samt internem Zugangsschlüssel.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-internal-api/src/handlers/python_stubs.rs:243-258 lässt den Bridge-Aufruf ohne optionalen Owner-Header zu; :372 ruft send_chat_action auf. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/bin/tb-bot/src/chat_wiring.rs:465 und :567-576 senden die Nachricht tatsächlich.
countermeasures: Admin- und Owner-Prüfung sind wirksam gegen unberechtigte Sitzungen, ersetzen aber keine Formularprüfung: /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/admin_chat_action.rs:71-90.

SameSite=Lax und HttpOnly begrenzen klassische fremdseitige Browserangriffe: /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/auth/discord_admin_login.rs:920-934. Sie erzwingen keinen korrekten Formularwert.
Forward-Auth prüft Sitzung und Gerätebindung, nicht den Request-Body: /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/forward_auth.rs:9-13 und :55-89.

Der absichtliche tokenlose Herkunfts-Fallback gehört zur separaten Middleware, nicht zu dieser Route: /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/auth/csrf.rs:106-140. Die geprüften Sitzungsconstraints und Partner-View prüfen ebenfalls keinen Formularwert: /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/migrations/20260831090000_dashboard_session_ids_sha256.sql:25-30 und /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/migrations/20260623150000_drop_manual_verified_columns.sql:20-64.
gaps: Strikt statische Gegenprüfung: keine Tests, Browser-, Netzwerk- oder Datenbankprobes ausgeführt. Im Handler-Testmodul ist kein Ablehnungstest für ungültige Owner-CSRF-POSTs vorhanden.
Die aktive externe Proxy-Konfiguration und eine vom Angreifer kontrollierte Same-Site-Herkunft wurden nicht nachgewiesen. Daher keine Bestätigung eines Browser-Exploits der Klasse A.
Die im Portkommentar genannte Python-Originaldatei existiert am festen SHA nicht. Das Soll ist unabhängig davon durch Rust-Routervertrag, Formular-Gate und Client belegt.

countermeasures: Owner-only authorization at /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/admin_chat_action.rs:71-90 restricts callers but does not validate request intent.

Admin cookies use HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax and optional Secure at /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/auth/discord_admin_login.rs:920-935. This limits ordinary cross-site POST attacks, not the demonstrated form-token contract violation.

Caddy's documented forward-auth contract checks session authorization without reading the body: /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/forward_auth.rs:9-13,55-89.
The internal bot route requires loopback and internal credentials, but the dashboard bridge supplies those credentials itself. Neither layer receives or validates the original form token.
expected_behavior_evidence: /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/lib.rs:1501-1508 explicitly requires legacy form handlers to validate body csrf_token themselves instead of using header middleware.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/legacy_form.rs:34-58 specifies session-bound form validation and rejection of invalid tokens; lines 78-96 implement that check.
/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/auth/session.rs:1530-1559 requires an exact session-token match and rejects empty tokens.
/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/bot/admin_dashboard/src/api/client.ts:1195-1205,1274-1280 supplies csrf_token in the form body for this exact action.
result.failure_scenario: An authenticated Discord owner, in an admin request context, submits POST /twitch/admin/chat_action with login=nani&mode=message&message=hi&csrf_token=wrong. Given an allowed active partner and a working bot bridge, the handler authenticates the owner, accepts the fields and invokes the chat send without rejecting the incorrect token. Omitting csrf_token behaves identically. The documented legacy-form contract requires rejection before sending.
gaps: Read-only source analysis at SHA 0ecae1370f1a80d1a101249b5c932663d69be8af; no builds, tests or runtime requests were executed.
A deployment-level attacker-controlled browser origin and the live reverse-proxy configuration were not established. Therefore an exploitable class-A CSRF attack is not claimed.

The handler tests at /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/admin_chat_action.rs:336-511 cover normalization, partner eligibility and unauthenticated rejection, not an authenticated owner's missing or incorrect CSRF token.
reachability_evidence: /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/lib.rs:1567-1571 registers this POST without a CSRF layer; line 2232 merges it into the production router.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/bin/tb-dashboard/src/main.rs:476-524 constructs that router and injects session state. Its remaining server wrappers do not add a global CSRF guard.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/admin_chat_action.rs:64-131 parses the form, checks privilege, owner identity and partner eligibility, then calls bridge_chat_action. It never reads csrf_token or calls legacy_form::gate.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/auth/session.rs:1624-1650,1993-2038 loads the owner identity using session validity and decrypted payload, independently of the presented form token.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/admin_chat_action.rs:260-277 forwards only mode, color and message with internal credentials. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-internal-api/src/handlers/python_stubs.rs:249-258,301-372 allows the authenticated bridge and invokes the chat port without any form-CSRF check.
result.reason: The attempted refutation found authorization and cookie defenses, but no mechanism enforcing this route's explicit body-token requirement. A concrete authenticated request with an incorrect token reaches the send path. This confirms a class-B contract bug; a separately exploitable browser-CSRF vulnerability is not proven.

findings.problem_de: Erhaltener Claim: Alter Admin-Cookie verdeckt Discord-Zuordnung.
findings.prerequisites_de: Voraussetzungen und Gegenbelege stehen im erhaltenen Original; keine neue Bewertung durch diese Dokumentationsrolle.

resolved_candidate_group.claim: A stale first master_dash_session cookie suppresses the authenticated admin's Discord attribution.

original_members.claim: A stale first master_dash_session cookie suppresses the authenticated admin's Discord attribution.
original_members.failure_scenario: An announcement-save request contains master_dash_session=expired; master_dash_session=valid. The second cookie belongs to the authenticated admin, and its CSRF/origin checks pass. admin_actor_label reads only the expired first cookie and persists updated_by=admin instead of discord:<authenticated-id>. The same ordering also makes an authenticated owner fail the chat-action owner check.
original_members.evidence: The first-match cookie reader at lines 6-15 feeds the single lookup at 27-34. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/admin_announcements.rs:92-94 passes that fallback label to storage. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-analytics/src/promo_mode.rs:615-666 persists and returns the supplied updated_by unchanged. Authentication instead iterates all admin cookies and records the selected session at /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/auth/level.rs:408-473; its test at 872-917 explicitly authenticates the valid second cookie. Confirmed twins: /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/admin_chat_action.rs:156-183 repeats first-cookie identity resolution, and /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/admin_audit.rs:54-87,110-117 repeats it for persistent request-audit attribution.
original_members.expected_behavior: Resolve the updater and owner identity from the server-authenticated admin session, including when stale duplicate cookies precede it. Preserve the generic fallback for genuinely identity-less contexts.
original_members.countermeasures: Session payload validation prevents fabricated Discord identities, and authentication correctly accepts the valid second cookie. CSRF middleware also honors the selected session, so it does not stop the affected announcement save. Persistent request auditing is not a compensating attribution layer because its cookie selection has the same defect. The documented forward-auth implementation does not reject this stale-first case: an absent first-cookie fingerprint returns Ok(None) and leaves the already-resolved admin authorization intact.

Das ist eine lokale Client-Umgehung, keine API-Validierung.

resolved_candidate_group.claim: Reverifying a single-row partner erases its removal history and never produces a restore audit entry.

original_members.claim: Reverifying a single-row partner erases its removal history and never produces a restore audit entry.
original_members.failure_scenario: A partner has one row initially added in January. Remove it in February, then reverify it through the native internal verification route in March. Reverification reuses that row, sets it active and clears departnered_at. A subsequent streamer_history audit contains only the original January 'added' entry. The February removal disappears and no March restore event appears.
original_members.evidence: admin_audit_log.rs:243-250 reads only current partner rows; 289-291 infers restore solely from a previously encountered inactive row; 326-345 depends on currently retained inactive status and timestamps. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-internal-api/src/handlers/streamers.rs:794-819 reaches promote_streamer_to_partner. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-internal-api/src/streamer_lifecycle.rs:529-560 reactivates the same row, preserves its original partnered_at and clears its removal timestamp. The separate reactivate_partner implementation at 705-719 similarly clears history and replaces partnered_at.
original_members.expected_behavior: Lifecycle audit entries should retain removals and distinguish restoration from first addition. The loader's contract at admin_audit_log.rs:238-241 and restore/remove test at 932-952 explicitly require that distinction.
original_members.countermeasures: The generic admin_request source records dashboard mutation routes, but it cannot reconstruct missing lifecycle timestamps or the target of body-based legacy actions. No inactive predecessor exists in this scenario for prior_inactive to inspect. Correct historical reconstruction requires a durable event-history design or storage migration, so this is C rather than an automatic minimal fix.

The endpoint saves that empty value and returns success, deleting the previous text instead of saving '123' or rejecting the malformed input.

result.reason: Confirmed by source-level interleaving at SHA 0ecae1370f1a80d1a101249b5c932663d69be8af. The announcement handler converts a previously read configuration into a full replacement. Saving text has silently undone B's deactivation.

findings.problem_de: Erhaltener Claim: Audit lädt sämtliche Billing-Inhalte vor Filterung.
findings.prerequisites_de: Voraussetzungen und Gegenbelege stehen im erhaltenen Original; keine neue Bewertung durch diese Dokumentationsrolle.

resolved_candidate_group.claim: The audit endpoint buffers every billing payload before applying request filters and limits.

original_members.claim: The audit endpoint buffers every billing payload before applying request filters and limits.
original_members.failure_scenario: With 100,000 distinct retained billing events containing 16 KiB payloads and a dashboard process with a 512 MiB available memory budget, an authenticated GET /twitch/api/admin/audit-log?source=promo&limit=1 attempts to allocate over 1.5 GiB of payload strings alone. The process exhausts memory before returning the single requested entry, even though billing is excluded from the response.
original_members.evidence: At the fixed review SHA, lines 527-544 SELECT every billing event including its raw payload, use fetch_all, and parse each payload. Lines 835-859 invoke this loader regardless of source or since. Filtering, sorting and limiting occur only afterward at lines 706-750. The same unbounded fetch_all pattern appears in the partner, manual-plan and subscription loaders at lines 242-253, 352-360 and 577-586. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-analytics/src/stripe/webhook_apply.rs:783-810 inserts each distinct event and retains its payload; /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/migrations/20260630144000_billing_events_runtime_table.sql:4-12 imposes no history-size bound. No retention path was found in the targeted billing-history reference search. No runtime reproduction was performed.
original_members.expected_behavior: The endpoint documents filtered, newest-first results and clamps the response to at most 500 entries. Its tests at lines 1133-1164 also require exact totalCount, hasMore and pre-source-filter sources. Preserve these semantics while bounding materialization. Classified C because the contract defines response semantics, not a resource budget, and a naive SQL LIMIT would change those semantics; a bounded aggregation strategy needs design review.
original_members.countermeasures: Admin authorization at lines 768-770 and webhook signature verification prevent an anonymous caller from directly supplying the scenario. The 500-entry response cap and 5000-row admin-request cap do not constrain billing payload allocations. Distinct-event deduplication does not bound history growth. Consider separate counts/source discovery and bounded or batched entry retrieval without changing the documented response.

original_members.failure_scenario: A streamer completes normal OAuth partner setup. original_members.evidence: At review SHA 0ecae1370f1a80d1a101249b5c932663d69be8af, the assigned handler resolves the ID at lines 293-302 and passes it to set_discord_profile at lines 304-311. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-analytics/src/streamers_crud.rs:857-875 accepts a supplied ID only if SELECT FROM twitch_streamers WHERE twitch_user_id finds a row, otherwise returning false. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-raid/src/partner_setup.rs:1148-1164 invokes normal promotion with clear_source=true; lines 956-967 delete that source row. result.reason: At fixed SHA 0ecae1370f1a80d1a101249b5c932663d69be8af, the mounted form alias invokes a partner-existence SELECT instead of the promotion lifecycle. The helper explicitly documents this incomplete implementation and says verification must remain proxied until promotion is implemented. Native mounting removes that protection. result.failure_scenario: An existing twitch_streamers row has login 'comeback' and Twitch ID '888'. Its matching twitch_partners row is status='departnered', manual_partner_opt_out=1, with no signup block or identity conflict. This state is produced by verification mode='clear' and remains visible as non_partner in the admin detail page. An administrator with a valid session and matching body CSRF selects permanent verification. POST /twitch/verify reaches verify_streamer, finds no active partner, and redirects with the message 'comeback ist nicht gespeichert'. No partner activation occurs, although the intended lifecycle would reactivate the existing row and clear manual_partner_opt_out. The same failure occurs with mode='temp'.

resolved_candidate_group.claim: Retrying a failed admin removal can report success without disabling the streamer's raid authorization.

original_members.claim: Retrying a failed admin removal can report success without disabling the streamer's raid authorization.
original_members.failure_scenario: An active partner has raid_enabled=true. During POST /twitch/remove, the partner-status update commits, but the subsequent raid-authorization update encounters a transient SQL error. The first request reports failure. After the database recovers, retrying the same request reports '<login> removed', while raid_enabled remains true and the engagement-disable step remains unexecuted.
original_members.evidence: At the fixed review SHA, do_remove calls departner_streamer and falls back to remove_streamer when it returns None; NotFound is mapped to a successful 'removed' message at lines 253-261. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-analytics/src/streamers_crud.rs:405-424 selects only active partners; lines 495-538 independently execute the status update and subsequent raid-disable update through PgPool, without a transaction. After the first status update, retries cannot select that partner. The fallback at lines 242-283 neither disables raid authorization nor engagement. This is a source trace, not an executed failure-injection test.
original_members.expected_behavior: A successful removal must complete the documented departure lifecycle, including raid-authorization disable, or continue reporting incomplete removal. The assigned handler's contract at lines 155-163 names this cleanup. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-analytics/src/streamers_crud.rs:1675-1691 explicitly tests raid_enabled=false and engagement enabled=false after departure.
original_members.countermeasures: Admin and form-CSRF gates restrict callers but provide no transaction or recovery. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/admin_audit.rs:118-136 only observes the result. The checked role definition permits dashboard DML at /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/ops/systemd/twitch-runtime-roles.sql:62-65. The form verify clear/failed path shares the same partial-departure problem. A targeted domain twin exists at /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-internal-api/src/streamer_lifecycle.rs:260-308; other token cleanup paths are event-specific and do not repair this request's retry.

original_members.claim: Nach unterbrochener Legacy-Partnerentfernung kann ein erfolgreicher Wiederholungsaufruf die Raid-Freigabe eingeschaltet lassen.
original_members.failure_scenario: Ein aktiver Partner hat raid_enabled=true. Bei POST /twitch/remove wird status=departnered bereits committed; anschließend beendet sich der Dienst oder das folgende Raid-Auth-UPDATE scheitert. Nach Wiederanlauf wird die Entfernung wiederholt. departner_streamer findet keinen aktiven Partner mehr, der Fallback remove_streamer löscht wegen des vorhandenen Partner-Eintrags nichts und liefert NotFound. do_remove meldet trotzdem removed; raid_enabled bleibt true.
original_members.evidence: /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-analytics/src/streamers_crud.rs:495-538 führt Partner-UPDATE und Raid-Auth-UPDATE getrennt über execute(pool) aus. Zeilen 405-424 beenden Wiederholungen bei nicht aktivem Status vor der Bereinigung. Der Primärpfad /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/admin_legacy_streamers.rs:253-260 behandelt den Fallback NotFound als Erfolg. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-analytics/src/streamers_crud.rs:257-283 verhindert das Löschen vorhandener Partner und bereinigt nur noch Live-State. Der gezielt gelesene interne Lifecycle-Zwilling führt seine Pflichtupdates ebenfalls ohne gemeinsame Transaktion aus.
original_members.expected_behavior: Die vollständige Partnerentfernung muss die gespeicherte Raid-Freigabe deaktivieren. Der Primärvertrag in Zeilen 157-163 nennt den vollständigen DB-Lifecycle; /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-analytics/src/streamers_crud.rs:1675-1682 prüft ausdrücklich raid_enabled=false.
original_members.countermeasures: Die Partner-Existenzprüfung schützt vor versehentlichem Löschen, macht aber das ausstehende Auth-UPDATE nicht nachholbar. Der geprüfte Partner-Trigger deaktiviert Raid-Auth nicht. Eine gemeinsame Transaktion oder eine Bereinigung auch bei bereits deaktivierten Partnern fehlt in diesem Pfad. Es wird keine weitere Bot-Aktion trotz deaktiviertem Partnerstatus behauptet; der Befund betrifft die unvollständige DB-Wirkung und den erfolgreichen Retry.

claim.claim: Retrying a failed admin removal can report success without disabling the streamer's raid authorization.

result.reason: Die Behauptung ist am SHA 0ecae1370f1a80d1a101249b5c932663d69be8af bestätigt. Partnerstatus und Raid-Freigabe werden unabhängig über den Pool geschrieben. Scheitert der zweite Schreibschritt, überspringt eine Wiederholung die notwendige Raid-Deaktivierung und meldet Erfolg. Das ist ein belegter Fehler bei Wiederholungen, keine nachgewiesene Sicherheitslücke.
result.failure_scenario: Ausgangszustand: Partner 'part' mit status='active', twitch_user_id='77' und passender twitch_raid_auth-Zeile mit raid_enabled=TRUE. Ein angemeldeter Admin sendet POST /twitch/remove mit gültigem CSRF-Wert und login=part. Der Partner-UPDATE wird erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Vor dem anschließenden Raid-UPDATE führt Pool-Auslastung zu einem Acquire-Timeout; die Raid-Abfrage wird nicht ausgeführt. Der erste Aufruf liefert ?err=could%20not%20remove, während status bereits 'departnered' und raid_enabled weiterhin TRUE ist. Nach Erholung des Pools wiederholt der Admin die Anfrage. Die Suche nach einem aktiven Partner liefert nun None. Der Fallback archiviert keinen aktiven Partner und löscht den Streamer wegen des vorhandenen Partnerdatensatzes nicht. Nach erfolgreichem Live-State-Cleanup liefert er NotFound, das do_remove in 'part removed' umwandelt. Die Antwort enthält ?ok=part%20removed, ohne raid_enabled zu ändern.
expected_behavior_evidence: /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/admin_legacy_streamers.rs:155-163 dokumentiert für diese Remove-Route den vollständigen DB-Lifecycle einschließlich Raid-Auth-Disable; nur das Discord-Rollen-Removal ist ausdrücklich ein Handoff.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-analytics/src/streamers_crud.rs:385-392 und 525-538 verlangen und implementieren raid_enabled=FALSE unabhängig von clear_verification.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/bot/admin_dashboard/src/pages/streamers/StreamerDetail.tsx:823-827 verspricht beim Entfernen den Verlust operativer Partnerfunktionen einschließlich Auto-Raid. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-analytics/src/streamers_crud.rs:1675-1682 prüft die deaktivierte Raid-Freigabe im normalen Departner-Ablauf.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/lib.rs:1549-1551 und 2232 registriert und integriert die native Route. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/bin/tb-dashboard/src/main.rs:476-483 und 494-511 setzt den Legacy-Proxy ausschließlich als Fallback ein.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/legacy_form.rs:40-58 erlaubt gültige Admin-Anfragen mit gültigem Session-CSRF. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/admin_legacy_streamers.rs:171-184 prüft keinen bereits begonnenen Removal-Zustand und reicht Domänenfehler als Fehler-Redirect weiter.

Es gibt keine gemeinsame Transaktion, die den ersten UPDATE beim zweiten Fehler zurückrollt.

Die behauptete generelle Lesebeschränkung wird durch die feste Codebasis nicht gestützt.

Die geprüften Migrations-Constraints erzwingen keine Kopplung von Partnerstatus und raid_enabled.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/admin_audit.rs:118-136 protokolliert den Antwortstatus lediglich best-effort. Es prüft weder den Endzustand noch repariert es Teilmutationen.

gaps: Strikt statische Prüfung: keine Tests, Builds, Datenbank- oder Netzwerkprobes ausgeführt. Ein tatsächlicher Produktionsvorfall wurde nicht behauptet oder nachgewiesen.

Die gelesenen Removal-Tests in /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/admin_legacy_streamers.rs:492-535 und /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-analytics/src/streamers_crud.rs:1618-1728 prüfen keinen Wiederholungsfall nach fehlgeschlagenem Raid-UPDATE.

Nachgewiesen ist die falsche Erfolgsmeldung bei weiterhin gesetzter Raid-Freigabe. Dass anschließend tatsächlich ein Raid ausgeführt wird, wurde nicht vollständig verfolgt und ist für dieses B-Urteil nicht erforderlich.

resolved_candidate_group.claim: A legal-document read failure can be followed by a successful save that deletes other pages' overrides.

original_members.claim: A legal-document read failure can be followed by a successful save that deletes other pages' overrides.
original_members.failure_scenario: The shared legal JSON contains custom overrides for several slugs. Its owner can write but cannot read it, for example after permissions become write-only. An admin saves one slug. Reading the existing document fails, the saver initializes an empty object, and the writable file is replaced with only the edited slug. The response reports success; the other public pages revert to defaults.
original_members.evidence: Lines 145-151 convert every read error, parse error and non-object document into an empty object. Lines 152-165 then write this replacement without reporting the lost input. The preliminary load at lines 198 and 101-110 also hides read errors, so it does not prevent the destructive save.
original_members.expected_behavior: Editing one slug should preserve unrelated overrides, or report inability to read the existing document. The shared-document editor contract is stated at /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/bot/admin_dashboard/src/pages/content/Legal.tsx:107-109. Classification is C because the saver explicitly documents legacy error-to-empty behavior; the intended corruption/recovery policy needs confirmation before changing it.
original_members.countermeasures: Write and directory-creation failures are propagated at lines 160-164 and 213-218, but a successful write after a failed read is not protected. Embedded defaults keep pages renderable but do not preserve custom content. Existing tests cover absent files and ordinary round trips, not read failure with existing overrides.

result.reason: Confirmed lost-update bug at fixed SHA 0ecae1370f1a80d1a101249b5c932663d69be8af. Legacy clear/failed verification reads Discord data and subsequently writes that snapshot back without a shared lock or version check. A committed intervening profile change is overwritten, contrary to the explicit identity-preservation contract. This is an authenticated administrative correctness defect, not a demonstrated security vulnerability.
result.failure_scenario: Existing active partner alice has Twitch ID 42, matching streamer and raid-auth records, and identity (Discord ID 111, display name Old, membership 1). Both Discord IDs 111 and 222 are otherwise unused. Authorized request A posts /twitch/verify with mode=clear or failed and valid session CSRF. After A reads the identity, authorized request B posts /twitch/discord_link and commits (Discord ID 222, display name New, membership 0). A then executes its identity upsert using its previously read values. The final identity is again (111, Old, 1), although B reported successful storage. A also successfully deactivates the partner. No uniqueness constraint is violated.

result.reason: At SHA 0ecae1370f1a80d1a101249b5c932663d69be8af, both toggle modes read the state and then perform an unconditional assignment in a separate database statement. Two successful requests can therefore apply only one effective inversion. This confirms repeated toggles of the same state, not an archive toggle and a block toggle overwriting each other's distinct columns.
result.failure_scenario: One existing partner has admin_archived_at=NULL. Two authenticated, CSRF-valid POST /twitch/archive requests specify the same login and mode=toggle. Both complete their initial handler lookup and both SELECTs in archive_streamer before either UPDATE. Both consequently execute SET admin_archived_at=NOW(); both return success, but the final state is archived. Two toggles should instead restore the unarchived state. The interleaving follows /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-analytics/src/streamers_crud.rs:747-782. Likewise, two mode=toggle_block requests starting with technical_pause_reason='blocked' can both read 'blocked' and both clear it, leaving the partner unblocked instead of blocked; see the same file:712-745.
expected_behavior_evidence: /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-analytics/src/streamers_crud.rs:641-649 explicitly defines Toggle as switching NULL versus an archive timestamp and ToggleBlock as switching 'blocked' versus NULL.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/docs/HOST_ROUTING_CONTRACT.md:17-22,66-72 permits public-host /twitch/* requests with explicit admin mode. /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/auth/level.rs:239-261,414-468 admits valid admin sessions in that mode.

/home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/bin/tb-dashboard/src/main.rs:400,476-483,497-511,604-608 uses the normal pool and serves the router through Axum. The legacy proxy is only a fallback, not an interceptor for this registered route.
countermeasures: Admin authentication and form CSRF checks restrict who can invoke the handler, but do not serialize accepted requests. CSRF validation compares a reusable stored value rather than consuming it: /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/handlers/legacy_form.rs:40-58,78-96; /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/rust/crates/tb-dashboard-api/src/auth/session.rs:1537-1559.

The actual SPA buttons send explicit archive/unarchive and block/unblock states, which avoids this double-toggle scenario for ordinary button clicks. Their pending guards do not change the supported toggle API contract: /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/bot/admin_dashboard/src/pages/streamers/StreamerDetail.tsx:374-405; /home/nathanael/.worktrees/tb-vollreview-artefakte/bot/admin_dashboard/src/pages/streamers/StreamerList.tsx:301-304,637-650.

The tracked partner schema permits both resulting values. gaps: No tests, builds, database requests or HTTP probes were run. The confirmation is a fixed-revision source-level interleaving proof, not evidence of an observed production incident.
